dataset: Number Garden focused subset of Marble Skill Taxonomy v1
attribution: Marble Skill Taxonomy (v1) © Generative Spark, Inc. (Marble), https://withmarble.com
modifications: Focused subset. Display names omit parenthetical age suffixes. No curriculum standard text or child/user data included.

topics.name: The two digits of a two-digit number
topics.description: Understand that the two digits of a two-digit number represent amounts of tens and ones

topics.name: The three digits of a three-digit number
topics.description: Understand that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones

topics.name: Place Value to 1000
topics.description: Solve number problems and practical problems involving place value of numbers up to 1000

topics.name: Addition and subtraction within 20
topics.description: Add and subtract within 20 using strategies such as making ten, decomposing a number leading to ten, and using known facts

topics.name: Multiplication and Division Word Problems
topics.description: Use multiplication and division within 100 to solve word problems involving equal groups, arrays, and measurement quantities

topics.name: Multiply & Add Problems
topics.description: Solve problems involving multiplying and adding, including using the distributive law, integer scaling problems, and harder correspondence problems

topics.name: Two-Step Equations
topics.description: Solve two-step word problems using the four operations; represent problems using equations with a letter standing for the unknown quantity

topics.name: What Is a Half?
topics.description: Recognise, find, and name a half as one of two equal parts of an object, shape, or quantity

topics.name: Unit fractions
topics.description: Recognise, find, and write fractions of a discrete set of objects: unit fractions and non-unit fractions with small denominators

topics.name: Fractions of amounts (harder)
topics.description: Solve problems involving increasingly harder fractions to calculate quantities, including non-unit fractions where the answer is a whole number

topics.name: Finding halves and quarters
topics.description: Recognise, find, and name a quarter as one of four equal parts of an object, shape, or quantity

topics.name: Counting in 2s
topics.description: Count in multiples of 2, 5, and 10 (skip counting)

topics.name: Skip Counting (4s, 8s, 50s, 100s)
topics.description: Count from 0 in multiples of 4, 8, 50, and 100

topics.name: Shape patterns
topics.description: Generate a number or shape pattern that follows a given rule; identify apparent features of the pattern not explicit in the rule and explain informally why they occur

topics.name: 2-D shapes
topics.description: Recognise and name common 2-D shapes (circles, triangles, rectangles including squares)

topics.name: 2-D shapes
topics.description: Identify lines of symmetry in 2-D shapes presented in different orientations; recognise line-symmetric figures and draw lines of symmetry

topics.name: 2-D shapes
topics.description: Identify and describe properties of 2-D shapes including the number of sides and line symmetry in a vertical line

topics.name: Right Angles & Turns
topics.description: Identify right angles; recognise that two right angles make a half-turn, three make three-quarters, and four make a complete turn

topics.name: Measuring length
topics.description: Measure the length of an object using same-size length units laid end to end with no gaps or overlaps

topics.name: Measuring length
topics.description: Measure the length of an object by selecting and using appropriate tools such as rulers, yardsticks, metre sticks, and measuring tapes

topics.name: Perimeters of polygons
topics.description: Solve problems involving perimeters of polygons: find perimeter from side lengths, find an unknown side length, and explore rectangles with same perimeter but different areas (or vice versa)

topics.name: Area
topics.description: Measure areas by counting unit squares (square cm, square m, square in, square ft)

topics.name: Unknown in Addition & Subtraction
topics.description: Determine the unknown whole number in an addition or subtraction equation relating three whole numbers

topics.name: Two-Step Word Problems
topics.description: Solve one- and two-step word problems within 100 using addition and subtraction, with unknowns in all positions

topics.name: Justifying mathematical reasoning
topics.description: Construct and follow multi-step mathematical arguments; identify errors in reasoning and explain why a method works or does not work

topics.name: Inverse: addition undoes subtraction
topics.description: Recognise and use the inverse relationship between addition and subtraction to check calculations and solve missing-number problems

topics.name: What the equals sign means
topics.description: Understand the meaning of the equal sign as 'is the same as' and determine if equations are true or false

topics.name: Adding Fractions (Same Denominator)
topics.description: Add and subtract fractions with the same denominator, including results greater than one whole (e.g. 5/8 + 6/8 = 11/8)

topics.name: 10 or 100 More or Less
topics.description: Find 10 or 100 more or less than a given number up to 1000

topics.name: Patterns in Times Tables
topics.description: Identify arithmetic patterns (including patterns in the addition table or multiplication table) and explain them using properties of operations

topics.name: Fluent adding and subtracting within 1000
topics.description: Fluently add and subtract within 1000 using strategies and algorithms based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction

topics.name: Rounding to 10, 100, 1000
topics.description: Round any number to the nearest 10, 100, or 1000

topics.name: A Hundred Is Ten Tens
topics.description: Understand that 100 can be thought of as a bundle of ten tens — called a 'hundred'

topics.name: Written Multiplication
topics.description: Multiply two-digit and three-digit numbers by a one-digit number using formal written layout

topics.name: Multi-Step Multiply & Divide
topics.description: Solve problems involving multiplication and division, including scaling problems and correspondence problems where n objects are connected to m objects

topics.name: Properties of Operations
topics.description: Apply properties of operations (commutative, associative, distributive) as strategies to multiply and divide

topics.name: Measuring length and height
topics.description: Measure and begin to record lengths and heights using non-standard and standard units

topics.name: Measuring length
topics.description: Order three objects by length and compare the lengths of two objects indirectly using a third object

topics.name: Choosing measurement units
topics.description: Choose and use appropriate standard units to measure length (m/cm), mass (kg/g), temperature (°C), and capacity (litres/ml) to the nearest appropriate unit

topics.name: Transformations on a grid
topics.description: Represent and carry out geometric transformations on squared paper or a coordinate grid: reflections (in horizontal, vertical, and diagonal mirror lines, including the axes), translations (described as a vector or as left/right/up/down moves), and rotations (90° or 180° about a stated centre point); describe each transformation precisely using the correct language; identify which transformation maps one shape onto its image by comparing position, orientation, and size

topics.name: Division as equal sharing
topics.description: Understand division as sharing equally into groups or as grouping (how many groups of a given size can be made)

topics.name: Fractions of amounts
topics.description: Recognise, find, name, and write fractions 1/3, 1/4, 2/4, and 3/4 of a length, shape, set of objects, or quantity

topics.name: Number bonds to 9
topics.description: Find the number that makes 10 when added to a given number from 1 to 9 (number bonds to 10)

topics.name: Fluent adding and subtracting within 10
topics.description: Fluently add and subtract within 10

topics.name: Understanding angles
topics.description: Recognise angles as a property of shape or a description of a turn

topics.name: Types of angles
topics.description: Use and interpret standard geometric diagram conventions: mark right angles with a small square, equal lengths with single or double tick marks, and equal angles with arc marks; label angles in three-letter notation (∠ABC) and individual angles with a single letter or number; draw diagrams showing angles at a point, angles on a straight line, and angles inside polygons with these conventions; read diagrams with these marks to identify given information and find unknown values

topics.name: Position, direction, and movement
topics.description: Use mathematical vocabulary to describe position, direction, and movement, including straight lines and distinguishing rotation as a turn in terms of right angles (quarter, half, three-quarter turns, clockwise and anti-clockwise)

topics.name: Rote counting to 100
topics.description: Rote count forwards and backwards from 0 to 100, beginning from 0, 1, or any given number, by ones

topics.name: Describing Aloud
topics.description: Describe familiar people, places, things, and events with detail; speak audibly and express thoughts, feelings, and ideas clearly; give well-structured descriptions and explanations

topics.name: Teaching It Back
topics.description: After learning something new, explain it in your own words — to yourself, a family member, or even a toy

topics.name: Explaining Mathematical Reasoning
topics.description: With teacher prompting, explain and justify mathematical reasoning using drawings, number sentences, or words

topics.name: Adding and subtracting
topics.description: Add and subtract numbers with up to three digits using formal written methods of columnar addition and subtraction

topics.name: Addition and subtraction strategies
topics.description: Explain why addition and subtraction strategies work, using place value and the properties of operations

topics.name: Angles in triangles
topics.description: Distinguish defining attributes of shapes (e.g. triangles are closed and three-sided) from non-defining attributes (e.g. colour, orientation, overall size)

topics.name: 3-D shapes
topics.description: Analyse and compare 2-D and 3-D shapes using informal language to describe sides, vertices, and other attributes

topics.name: A Ten Is Ten Ones
topics.description: Understand that 10 can be thought of as a bundle of ten ones — called a 'ten'

topics.name: The teen numbers
topics.description: Understand that the teen numbers (11–19) are composed of ten ones and some further ones (early place value)

topics.name: Understanding angles
topics.description: Multiply side lengths to find areas of rectangles and represent whole-number products as rectangular areas

topics.name: Measuring Perimeters
topics.description: Measure the perimeter of simple 2-D shapes

topics.name: Understanding Area
topics.description: Understand that a unit square has one square unit of area and that the area of a plane figure is the number of unit squares that cover it without gaps or overlaps

topics.name: Fluent adding and subtracting within 100
topics.description: Fluently add and subtract within 100 using strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and the relationship between addition and subtraction

topics.name: Early Word Problems
topics.description: Solve one-step word problems involving addition and subtraction to 20, including missing-number problems

topics.name: What Multiplication Means
topics.description: Interpret products of whole numbers (e.g. 5 × 7 as the total number of objects in 5 groups of 7)

topics.name: What Division Means
topics.description: Interpret whole-number quotients (e.g. 56 ÷ 8 as the number of objects in each share or the number of equal groups)
